confidence_notes: Can Tho's published food and drink data are sparse (three contributors in the past 18 months; last updated 25 February 2026). Meals, cappuccino and draft beer use the city price index; cocktail and wine-glass prices are approximate, with wine inferred partly from the local beer and mid-range bottle-wine relationship. Accommodation is a holistic estimate from general regional knowledge, without live listing checks.
comparable_city_reasoning: Can Tho is a secondary Mekong Delta city. Its own published food, cappuccino and draft-beer prices anchor those estimates; lodging reflects the lower budget-market level typical of regional Vietnamese cities compared with Ho Chi Minh City.
